What is This Part?
This is the Suzuki Samurai Complete Transmission Bearing Rebuild Kit.
Gives you everything you need to complete a rebuild without paying for unnecessary parts.
Includes a new Breather Plug & Back-Up Switch
Also Includes a new Clutch Release Shaft Spring & Bush
You also Get Additional Springs, Keys & Clips
Complete Needle & Roller Bears – with Input Oil Seal & Extension Case
(Japanese Standards Bearings) Made by FAG / NMK / Suzuki Japan / SKF
Direct Replacement
